answer: Labelled fraud is most concentrated in merchant city and state = Rome, Italy: 150 of 189 labelled frauds (79.4%), at 3.2 times the base rate.
sql:
WITH labelled AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t.transaction_type AS transaction_type_1,
    l.state AS merchant_state_1,
    l.city AS merchant_city_1,
    l.state AS merchant_city_2,
    m.mcc AS merchant_category_1,
    c.description AS merchant_category_2,
    CAST(strftime('%H', t.date) AS INTEGER) AS hour_1,
    COALESCE(t.errors, 'No error') AS error_1,
    CASE WHEN t.amount_usd_cents < 0 THEN 'negative'
      WHEN t.amount_usd_cents < 1000 THEN '$0 to under $10'
      WHEN t.amount_usd_cents < 5000 THEN '$10 to under $50'
      WHEN t.amount_usd_cents < 10000 THEN '$50 to under $100'
      WHEN t.amount_usd_cents < 50000 THEN '$100 to under $500'
      WHEN t.amount_usd_cents < 100000 THEN '$500 to under $1,000'
      ELSE '$1,000 and over' END AS amount_band_1,
    k.card_type AS card_type_1,
    k.card_brand AS card_brand_1,
    f.is_fraud AS is_fraud
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT)
  LEFT JOIN merchant_locations l ON l.id = t.merchant_location_id
  LEFT JOIN merchants m ON m.id = t.merchant_id
  LEFT JOIN mcc_codes c ON c.mcc = m.mcc
  LEFT JOIN cards k ON k.id = t.card_id
  WHERE f.is_fraud IS NOT NULL
),
segments AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT 'transaction_type' AS dimension, transaction_type_1 AS key1, NULL AS key2,
         count(*) AS labelled, sum(is_fraud) AS fraud
  FROM labelled GROUP BY transaction_type_1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'merchant_state' AS dimension, merchant_state_1 AS key1, NULL AS key2,
         count(*) AS labelled, sum(is_fraud) AS fraud
  FROM labelled GROUP BY merchant_state_1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'merchant_city' AS dimension, merchant_city_1 AS key1, merchant_city_2 AS key2,
         count(*) AS labelled, sum(is_fraud) AS fraud
  FROM labelled GROUP BY merchant_city_1, merchant_city_2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'merchant_category' AS dimension, merchant_category_1 AS key1, merchant_category_2 AS key2,
         count(*) AS labelled, sum(is_fraud) AS fraud
  FROM labelled GROUP BY merchant_category_1, merchant_category_2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'hour' AS dimension, hour_1 AS key1, NULL AS key2,
         count(*) AS labelled, sum(is_fraud) AS fraud
  FROM labelled GROUP BY hour_1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'error' AS dimension, error_1 AS key1, NULL AS key2,
         count(*) AS labelled, sum(is_fraud) AS fraud
  FROM labelled GROUP BY error_1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'amount_band' AS dimension, amount_band_1 AS key1, NULL AS key2,
         count(*) AS labelled, sum(is_fraud) AS fraud
  FROM labelled GROUP BY amount_band_1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'card_type' AS dimension, card_type_1 AS key1, NULL AS key2,
         count(*) AS labelled, sum(is_fraud) AS fraud
  FROM labelled GROUP BY card_type_1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'card_brand' AS dimension, card_brand_1 AS key1, NULL AS key2,
         count(*) AS labelled, sum(is_fraud) AS fraud
  FROM labelled GROUP BY card_brand_1
)
SELECT 'listed' AS row_kind, dimension, key1, key2, labelled, fraud,
       1 AS segments, 1 AS segments_with_fraud
FROM segments WHERE labelled >= 100 AND fraud >= 10
UNION ALL
SELECT 'below floor', dimension, NULL, NULL, sum(labelled), sum(fraud),
       count(*), sum(fraud > 0)
FROM segments WHERE NOT (labelled >= 100 AND fraud >= 10) GROUP BY dimension
UNION ALL
SELECT 'total', NULL, NULL, NULL, count(*), sum(is_fraud), NULL, NULL
FROM labelled
ORDER BY row_kind, dimension, fraud DESC, key1, key2

caveats.message: This result uses fraud labels, which only about two thirds of transactions have. An unlabelled transaction is unknown, not legitimate.

notes: Scanned 799 labelled transactions (all dates): 189 labelled frauds, a base rate of 23.655%.

A segment is listed when it has at least 100 labelled transactions and 10 frauds, and a fraud rate above the base rate. Of 28 segments in 9 dimensions, 9 are below that floor (6 of them with at least one fraud) and 10 pass it at or under the base rate.

merchant city and state = Rome, Italy holds exactly the same labelled transactions as transaction type = Chip Transaction; merchant state or country = Italy; hour of day = 11; error = No error; amount band = $10 to under $50; card type = Credit; card brand = Visa. It is listed once.

Outside merchant city and state = Rome, Italy, 39 labelled frauds remain in 599 labelled transactions, and 3 segment(s) still pass the floor: merchant city and state = Sacramento, CA; error = Insufficient Balance; merchant category (MCC) = 4829 Money Transfer.
1 of the other 1 listed segment(s) do not pass the floor without the top segment: they overlap it and are not findings of their own.
